summary_en: Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 to launch tender offer for all JPMC ordinary shares at ¥2,250/share. Tender period Aug 4–Sep 15, 2026 (30 business days). Minimum threshold 6,707,800 shares; no maximum stated. Settlement Sep 25, 2026.
title_en: Notice of commencement of tender offer for ordinary shares of Japan Property Management Center Co., Ltd. (Code: 3276) by Amsterdam1 Co., Ltd. and Amsterdam2 Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: Amsterdam1 Co., Ltd. and Amsterdam2 Co., Ltd. announced the commencement of a tender offer to acquire ordinary shares of Japan Property Management Center Co., Ltd. (listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime market, code 3276). The offer covers up to 12,303,225 ordinary shares at ¥2,250 per share. The tender period runs from August 4 to September 15, 2026, covering 30 business days, with a minimum acceptance threshold of 6,707,800 shares and no maximum limit stated. Settlement is scheduled for September 25, 2026. The tender offer agent is Nomura Securities Co., Ltd. This disclosure by the bidders is made pursuant to the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act as required by Article 30(1)(iv) of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act.
